layout: fixed right portrait card + left graphic stage; not content-aware floating placement
frameClock: 24fps target global clock; no loop or rate change; max uncovered pause 0.25s
autoAlignment: waveform correlation >=0.95 using separately supplied narration; explicit at also supported
faceCrop: median localization per segment, coverage >=80%; explicit normalized crop accepted; no identity recognition
output: 1080p default when presentation configured; 720p selectable; no-presentation route retains 720p
scope: presentation applies to graphic short scenes only; existing media/legacy scenes remain available without presentation
subtitles: none for this editorial route; SRT can supply content evidence without display
audio: unique narration with existing SFX; no automatic BGM; role/name may be empty strings
logo: optional; omitted does not block render; no organization logo supplied by default
